query:
SELECT fc.*, c.nome, c.empresaSlug, c.cashbarberProfissionalId 
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON fc.colaboradorId = c.id
WHERE c.nome = 'Renan'
ORDER BY fc.data DESC
LIMIT 20;
